translations.answer: The old implementation assumed all bodies were flat siblings under the same parent, combining leaf names into a single alternation; the Isaac Sim 6.0 link is recursive, and this pattern cannot express actual paths. #6378 (PhysX) and #6384 (OVPhysX) are both updated to construct per-body path expressions from parsing results. A single body per path expression is added, and nested hierarchy regression testing is included. The PhysX path must also handle list-pattern bodies by synchronizing the body-major raw ordering. The public `data` layout remains unchanged.
translations.applicability: Applies to Isaac Sim 6.0+ URDF importer generated nested rigid-body hierarchy, and similar structures in custom USD.
translations.credibility.rationale: The issue has been closed, environment is clear and non-conflicting, and precise references or independent reproducibility are available.
translations.details.attempts.0: PhysX PR #6378 and OVPhysX PR #6384 are updated to construct per-body path expressions from parsing results.
translations.details.diagnostics.0: Compare USD actual nested prim paths with the view pattern constructed from the first body parent and leaf names.
translations.details.effective_fixes.0: Upgrade to a version containing #6378 and #6384; do not use shared parent plus flat body names for ContactSensor patterns.
translations.details.environments.0: IsaacLab develop 3.0.0, Isaac Sim 6.0.0 pip, Python 3.12, Ubuntu 24.04, Linux 6.17.
translations.details.limits.0: The #6378 PhysX list-pattern API produces body-major raw row order; the patch is adapted internally, but user-defined raw-view indexes must be audited separately; public `data` remains `(num_envs, num_bodies, ...)`.
translations.details.limits.1: The fork PR environment for #6384 cannot execute OVPhysX wheelhouse test before merging; the PR explicitly states testing will be done on upstream/nightly.
translations.details.outcomes.0: Both PRs have been merged and approved by maintainers; they are now included in nested hierarchy regression coverage.
translations.details.problem_statements.0: Why does Isaac Sim 6.0's nested link cause ContactSensor's rigid/contact view to fail matching?
translations.details.safety_notes.0: After upgrade, perform end-to-end validation using body_names, data shape, and known body world positions to avoid sensor initialization but body/env index misalignment.
translations.details.suspected_causes.0: Nested bodies do not share a common parent; a single parent-level alternation cannot express each body's actual path.
translations.details.symptoms.0: `create_articulation_view` finds all 53 links, but `create_rigid_body_view` pattern only finds direct children or fails completely, and reports pattern did not match.
